test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Below are given alternatives to the underlined part. Select the correct alternative.

Kanha National Park in MP is the __dense__ forest in India.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. densest .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is comparing Kanha National Park to other forests in India.
 
• When comparing one item to all others within a group, the **superlative form** of the adjective should be used.
 
• The superlative form of "dense" is **"densest."**
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is: *Kanha National Park in MP is the **densest forest** in India.*

Correct sentence: *Kanha National Park in MP is the **densest** forest in India.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative form:**

 
 
• Used to compare two items.
 
• Structure: Adjective + "-er" (or "more" for longer adjectives).
 
• Example: This forest is **denser** than that one.
 
 
 
• **Superlative form:**
 
 
• Used to indicate the highest degree among three or more items.
 
• Structure: Adjective + "-est" (or "most" for longer adjectives).
 
• Example: This is the **densest** forest in the region.
